'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] shell [[Kherson]], injuring nine [[civilian]]s near an [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] point in a flooded part of the city following the [[Destruction of the Kakhovka Dam|destruction of the Kakhovka dam]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/06/08/world/europe/kherson-russian-shelling.html (''The New York Times'')]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] says it has destroyed several [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian army]] tanks in [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]], including a [[Leopard 2]] main battle tank, the first Western-made tank to be destroyed by [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] in the war. A video released by the ministry shows a column of tanks being hit in a field, with one of them confirmed to be a Leopard 2. [https://www.businessinsider.com/russia-says-video-shows-1st-leopard-tank-destroyed-in-ukraine-2023-6?r=US&IR=T (Business Insider)]
*[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
**[[2023 Fayzabad mosque bombing]]
***At least 11 people are killed and 30 others are injured by a [[car bomb]] outside a [[mosque]] in [[Fayzabad, Badakhshan|Fayzabad]], [[Afghanistan]], during a prayer service for the deputy governor of [[Badakhshan Province]] who was killed two days ago. The [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|Islamic State]] claimed responsibility. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-65842605 (BBC News)]
*Thirteen people are killed after intercommunal fighting in a camp in [[Malakal]], [[Upper Nile (state)|Upper Nile]], [[South Sudan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/fighting-south-sudan-displaced-peoples-camp-kills-13-un-2023-06-09/ (Reuters)]
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Samoa floods]]
**Heavy rains in [[Savaiʻi]], [[Samoa]], cause widespread [[flood]]ing and infrastructure damage. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/491603/heavy-rain-in-samoa-causes-flooding-infrastructure-damage (RNZ)]
*A [[Russia]]n national is killed by a [[tiger shark]] off the coast of [[Hurghada]], [[Egypt]]. Following the attack, authorities closed a {{conv|46|mile|km}} stretch of the [[Red Sea]] coast until 11 June. The shark was later captured. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jun/08/russian-man-dies-mauled-by-shark-egyptian-red-sea-resort (''The Guardian'')]
*The [[Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology|Philippine Institute of Volcanology]] issues a "level 3 alert" for [[Mayon|Mayon Volcano]] in [[Albay]] due to the presence of [[volcanic earthquake]]s, indicating an increased risk of [[lava]] flows and possible eruptions. Albay Governor [[Edcel Greco Lagman|Edcel Lagman]] orders the evacuation of residents within a {{conv|6|km|mi|sp=us}} radius of the volcano. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-raises-alert-level-rumbling-volcano-after-rockfall-quakes-2023-06-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 Marburg virus disease outbreak in Equatorial Guinea]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] announces that the outbreak of [[Marburg virus disease]] in [[Equatorial Guinea]], which has killed 35 people since February, has ended. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/health/marburg-outbreak-equitorial-guinea-who-1.6869705 (CBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[FBI investigation into Donald Trump's handling of government documents]]
**[[Federal prosecution of Donald Trump (classified documents case)|Federal prosecution of Donald Trump]]
***Former U.S. president [[Donald Trump]] is [[indict]]ed on thirty-seven counts related to his mishandling of classified government documents. He is due to be arraigned in federal court in [[Miami]], [[Florida]], on June 13. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2023/06/08/trump-classified-documents-mar-a-lago/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2023 Annecy stabbing]]
**Six people, including four children, are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at [[Lake Annecy]] in [[Haute-Savoie]], [[France]]. The attacker, a [[Syrians|Syrian]] national, is arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65841666 (BBC News)]
